title: Python: complete learning roadmap
intro: Follow these stages in order. Every stage lists the subjects you will meet and links to an existing guided lesson with a beginner explanation, a small worked example, practice steps, a check, and a project connection.
sourceNote: Coverage designed from the Python 3 language tutorial, language reference, standard library documentation, and Python Institute PCEP/PCAP objectives. Last reviewed: 2026-09-28.

stages.title: Start using Python
topics: What Python is and where it is useful
Installing Python and checking its version
Interpreter, REPL, scripts, command-line arguments, exit status, and __main__
Editor, terminal, formatter, linter, debugger, and tracebacks
Paths, working directories, encodings, newline differences, and cross-platform behaviour
Virtual environments and isolated dependencies
Git basics for a Python project

project.name: Personal command-line toolkit
project.build: Create a script folder with a virtual environment, README, .gitignore, and one useful command.

stages.title: Read and write your first programs
topics: Statements, expressions, indentation, comments, names, literals, and keywords
print(), input(), type conversion, formatting, and f-strings
Integers, floats, precedence, floor division, modulo, and exponentiation
Rounding, floating-point surprises, and decimal use cases
Comparisons, truthiness, short-circuit logic, chained comparisons, and is versus ==

project.name: Budget splitter
project.build: Ask for bill details, calculate shares, and print a friendly receipt.

stages.title: Make programs choose and repeat
topics: Variables, assignment, rebinding, dynamic typing, object identity, and equality
None, bool, int, float, complex, str, and bytes
if, elif, else, match/case, guards, and structural matching
for, while, range, break, continue, pass, and loop else
Tracing program state one step at a time

project.name: Menu-driven study timer
project.build: Build a repeatable menu that records study sessions and handles invalid choices.

stages.title: Store and shape information
topics: Strings, indexing, slicing, immutability, Unicode, escapes, formatting, and methods
Lists, mutation, slicing, copying, stacks, queues, and nested lists
Tuples, packing, unpacking, single-item tuples, and named tuples
Sets, frozensets, membership, set algebra, and hashability
Dictionaries, lookups, iteration, views, defaults, merging, order, and nested data
Iterable tools: unpacking, starred expressions, enumerate, zip, sorted, and reversed
Aliasing, shallow/deep copy, and mutable default-argument traps

project.name: Contact and inventory manager
project.build: Store contacts in nested data structures, search them, prevent duplicates, and safely copy before editing.

stages.title: Use collection power tools
topics: List, set, and dictionary comprehensions
Generator expressions and lazy processing
Iterable protocol and iterator exhaustion
Regular expressions, raw strings, groups, search, match, fullmatch, and substitution
JSON and CSV shapes, validation, and schema thinking

project.name: Log and CSV cleaner
project.build: Validate a CSV, clean text with a regular expression, and export a JSON summary.

stages.title: Organize behaviour with functions
topics: Functions, parameters, arguments, returns, None, and docstrings
Positional-only, keyword-only, defaults, *args, **kwargs, and unpacking
LEGB scope, global, nonlocal, closures, late binding, and shadowing
Recursion, base cases, stack limits, and iteration alternatives
First-class functions, lambda, map, filter, functools, and decorators
Generators, yield, yield from, and lazy evaluation
Type annotations, generics, protocols, TypedDict, dataclass, and static versus runtime checking

project.name: Reusable text-analysis library
project.build: Create typed, documented functions with configurable rules and a clean interface.

stages.title: Reuse code and manage projects
topics: Imports, module cache, sys.path, dir, and __name__
Modules, packages, __init__.py, relative imports, namespace packages, and public APIs
math, random, statistics, datetime, pathlib, os, sys, collections, itertools, and functools
pip, requirements, constraints, lock files, and dependency risks
pyproject.toml, builds, wheels, source distributions, metadata, versioning, and publishing concepts
Environment variables, argparse, configparser, and secret boundaries

project.name: Packaged command-line report tool
project.build: Turn your library into a package with configuration and repeatable setup.

stages.title: Handle failures and files safely
topics: Syntax errors, exceptions, tracebacks, and exception hierarchy
try/except/else/finally, raise, chaining, assertions, custom exceptions, and error boundaries
open(), modes, encoding, text/binary data, buffering, context managers, paths, and atomic writes
Creating context managers
JSON, CSV, pickle risks, untrusted input, and validation
Logging levels, handlers, formatters, context, and privacy
Breakpoints, pdb, and minimal reproducible examples

project.name: Resilient file importer
project.build: Import structured files, show useful errors, write safe output, and preserve privacy in logs.

stages.title: Model real things with classes
topics: Classes, instances, methods, self, constructors, attributes, and class versus instance state
Properties, encapsulation conventions, name mangling, __dict__, and introspection
Inheritance, composition, mixins, multiple inheritance, MRO, super, and polymorphism
Special methods for representation, comparison, arithmetic, containers, contexts, and iteration
dataclass, Enum, abstract base classes, and protocols
Descriptors, decorators, metaclasses, and class-creation hooks

project.name: Library lending model
project.build: Model books, members, loans, validation rules, and readable reports.

stages.title: Think efficiently
topics: Problem decomposition, specifications, preconditions, postconditions, and invariants
Big-O, Theta, Omega, amortized analysis, and time/space trade-offs
Divide-and-conquer, backtracking, dynamic programming, greedy, and randomized approaches
Searching, sorting, hashing, heaps, trees, graphs, traversals, shortest paths, union-find, and tries
Stacks, queues, deques, linked structures, hash tables, and priority queues
Logic, sets, relations, induction, counting, probability, and modular arithmetic
Floating-point reasoning, numerical stability, and reproducibility
Measuring a bottleneck before optimizing

project.name: Route and task planner
project.build: Select appropriate structures and implement a small priority planner.

stages.title: Understand performance and internals
topics: Names, bindings, references, lifetime, garbage collection, cycles, and weak references
Mutability, interning/caching caveats, copy semantics, and memory profiling
Bytecode, .pyc files, imports, frames, call stack, and namespaces
timeit, cProfile, benchmarking, and performance trade-offs
CPython GIL and implementation portability
Event loops, cooperative scheduling, cancellation, and backpressure

project.name: Performance improvement report
project.build: Profile a slow data task, improve the true bottleneck, and record before/after results.

stages.title: Run concurrent work and services
topics: Threads, locks, queues, races, deadlocks, and I/O-bound work
Processes, pools, IPC, pickling limits, and CPU-bound work
asyncio, coroutines, async/await, tasks, gather, timeouts, cancellation, and async contexts
Sockets, HTTP, REST, retries, idempotency, pagination, rate limits, and error handling
Webhooks, message queues, events, and background workers

project.name: Reliable API collector
project.build: Collect paginated information with timeouts, retries, rate-limit handling, and clear failures.

stages.title: Build services and data workflows
topics: SQL from Python, parameterized queries, transactions, connections, and SQLite/PostgreSQL concepts
ORMs, migrations, query performance, and the N+1 problem
API validation, authentication concepts, status codes, pagination, and versioning
Routing, request/response flow, templates, middleware, and background work
Flask/FastAPI/Django concepts
Caching, queues, scheduling, idempotency, and distributed failures
Requirements, user stories, contracts, domain modelling, boundaries, and dependency inversion
Layered, modular-monolith, client/server, event-driven, and microservice trade-offs
State machines, workflows, eventual consistency, ordering, and deduplication

project.name: Team task service
project.build: Design a small API and database-backed workflow with validation and transaction rules.

stages.title: Test, review, and secure your work
topics: Unit, integration, end-to-end, regression, property-based, and contract-test ideas
pytest discovery, assertions, fixtures, parametrization, mocks, temporary files, and coverage
unittest, unittest.mock, test doubles, and patching the correct namespace
Formatting, linting, type checking, documentation, and code review
Input validation, injection, unsafe deserialization, path traversal, secrets, dependencies, and subprocess safety
Accessibility, reliability, internationalization, helpful errors, and privacy-aware logs

project.name: Quality gate
project.build: Add a suite of tests, fixtures, mocked boundaries, input checks, and a secure-code checklist.

stages.title: Deliver and operate projects
topics: Project layout, README, licence, semantic versioning, changelog, and technical decisions
Containers and reproducible environments
CI/CD stages, artifacts, deployment gates, and rollback
Cloud/serverless building blocks
Metrics, traces, alerts, and incident-friendly logs
Linux/shell, signals, processes, and scheduled jobs
Issues, pull requests, review, agile delivery, and technical communication
Reading unfamiliar code, releases, deprecations, migrations, open-source work, and specialist pathways

project.name: Release-ready service
project.build: Package a service with documentation, container plan, CI checklist, monitoring plan, and release checklist.

stages.title: Use Python for data and science
topics: NumPy arrays, vectorization, broadcasting, views, copies, dtypes, and reproducible randomness
Tabular data, indexing, joins, groups, missing data, time series, and quality checks
Clear charts and misleading-chart pitfalls
Hypotheses, simulations, parameter sweeps, uncertainty, and experiment records
Memory locality, native extensions, distributed boundaries, and profiling
C/C++/Fortran interoperability, binary formats, array protocols, data pipelines, and ML service boundaries

project.name: Reproducible data-quality study
project.build: Prepare a dataset, document quality checks, calculate summaries, and make one honest chart.

stages.title: Explore extensions and embedding
topics: Tokens, parsing, ASTs, compilation, bytecode, frames, symbol tables, and imports
CPython objects, reference counting, cycle detection, GC interfaces, and weak references
Stable ABI, limited API, compatibility, subinterpreters, and caveats
Extension modules, argument parsing, exception translation, ownership, state, and build/link concerns
Extension types, buffer protocol, capsules, callbacks, and thread-state/GIL interaction
Embedding CPython and safe lifecycle/isolation
CPython, PyPy, Jython, and portability

project.name: Interpreter investigation
project.build: Inspect a small function with safe standard-library tools and document CPython-specific conclusions.

stages.title: Build reliable and responsible systems
topics: Threat modelling: assets, trust boundaries, attack surface, abuse cases, and mitigations
Authentication/authorization, sessions/tokens, crypto API boundaries, and secure defaults
Dependency provenance, pinning, advisories, SBOM ideas, licences, and upgrades
Secure deserialization, templates, subprocesses, filesystems, SSRF, injection, and reflection risks
Privacy, retention, encryption boundaries, audit logs, incidents, disclosure, and patches
SLIs/SLOs, capacity, load/failure testing, and post-incident learning

project.name: Secure release review
project.build: Create a lightweight threat model and reliability checklist for a previous project.

stages.title: Build interfaces and a capstone
topics: GUI and event-driven concepts
Networking, files, data processing, and standards at extension level
Backend, data, ML, QA, automation, security, scientific, DevOps, GUI, and embedded pathways
When Python is not the right tool

project.name: Choose-and-build capstone
project.build: Extend an earlier project with a clear user, repeatable setup, tests, documentation, and demonstration scenario.

stages.title: Practise certification-style reasoning
topics: PCEP: programming basics, values, control flow, collections, functions, and exceptions
PCAP: modules/packages, exceptions, strings, OOP, comprehensions, lambdas, closures, and I/O
PCPP: advanced OOP, GUI, networking, files/data processing, and standards
Code tracing, distractors, timed decisions, weak-area review, and exam calm

project.name: Personal revision plan
project.build: Use check results to choose three weak areas and plan targeted revision.
